resources.string: Keep your place, bookmarks and highlights the same on your phones and tablets, through a folder your cloud app keeps in step.

Pick a folder that your cloud app (such as Google Drive, Dropbox or OneDrive) or a sync app keeps the same on your other devices, and pick the same folder in ListenLock there. ListenLock writes your reading places, bookmarks, highlights and notes into it, and copies of your books if you want. ListenLock itself sends nothing anywhere: the folder\'s app moves the files, and anyone that app shares the folder with can read them.
The last sync could not reach the folder. Pick it again.
So your other devices can add them too. Books over 200 MB stay on this device only.
That folder\'s app doesn\'t let ListenLock keep writing to it. Pick a folder in another app or on this device.
The sync settings couldn\'t be saved. Free some space and try again.
Couldn\'t reach the sync folder. Open Sync through a folder and pick it again.
Synced. Everything was already up to date.
Sync stopped. The folder and its files stay where they are.
